authorization.authorized_now: offline implementation, tests, provenance and protocol freeze only
authorization.future_execution_requires: a separate committed execution amendment plus an active one-gNB/one-UE software-channel reservation

operational_anchor: oaitun_ue1 route to the data-network subnet is installed
stabilization_health_rules: UE remains attached at every one-second poll
gNB and UE containers remain running
gNB and UE restart counts remain zero
window_contract.stabilization_log_policy: all failure markers are counted and retained as startup diagnostics, but recovered markers before the cutoff are not charged to the post-stabilization safety gate
window_contract.observation_start: capture immutable gNB and UE log prefixes after ten continuously healthy stabilization seconds
window_contract.log_stream_rule: the final Docker log text must begin with the frozen prefix; a non-append-only stream fails closed
window_contract.failure_window: only the exact post-stabilization log suffix
window_contract.required_success_markers_window: full log, because PBCH, random access, RRC and registration necessarily precede the observation cutoff

next_comparable_diagnostic.independence_unit: forced recreation of both gNB and UE containers for each repetition

stopping_rules: stop before mutation on any repository, image, compose or baseline-health mismatch
stop if either container exits, restarts or attachment is absent at any stabilization or observation poll
during observation, stop on any frozen PBCH, PUSCH, random-access, RLC maximum-retransmission, unhandled-RLF, actual-RLF or lost-sync marker
stop if Docker logs are not append-only relative to the frozen observation prefixes
stop and roll back on any failed repetition; do not change thresholds or runtime parameters
do not mount or evaluate CIRDB data in this diagnostic
do not calculate MMD, compare absolute RSRP, infer parameters or run ABC

branch_after_future_execution.three_valid_passthrough_repetitions: freeze a separate CIRDB replay amendment using the same ten-second stabilization boundary
branch_after_future_execution.any_passthrough_failure: keep CIRDB closed and return to offline VRTSIM transport or scheduling diagnosis
